meta.title: Refactor CI workflow for parallel multi-architecture Docker builds
meta.body_summary: Refactor GitHub Actions CI workflow to build Docker images for amd64 and arm64 in parallel, claiming 20-25% build time reduction.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot refactored CI workflow for parallel builds; no formal reviews, closed after 17 days without merge; narrative performance claim without validation.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 176 changed lines in a single CI YAML file, this is a small config-level refactor by absolute volume. It fits a pipeline optimization PR that was closed without merge—likely due to lack of validation or maintainer engagement.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal reviews or human comments were recorded; only a SonarQube bot quality gate pass. The PR was closed after 17 days without any maintainer discussion.
review_details.performance_claim: Parallel multi-arch builds expected to be 20-25% faster; prior sequential builds were 25-30% longer.
review_details.rejection_signals: Closed by maor-rozenfeld after 17 days with no review activity; no negative feedback or explicit rejection reason.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Optimizing CI pipeline requires validation via actual CI runs and maintainer oversight; without testing in the real environment, the PR was closed unmerged.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No actual CI run logs or timing measurements; only narrative claims and YAML syntax validation.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: PR closed without merge; no testing or feedback preceded closure.

core_change_summary.description: Refactored .github/workflows/ci.yml to split monolithic Docker build job into parallel jobs for amd64 and arm64, with a final manifest creation step; preserved Lambda tagging and ECR caching.
change_trajectory: Single substantive commit: split build jobs, add parallel matrix, add manifest job; 150 additions, 26 deletions.

review_signals.summary: SonarQube Cloud analysis passed with 0 new issues, security hotspots, etc.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with CI workflow refactor
SonarQube bot posted quality gate pass
No human maintainer comments or reviews
